values.name: Timerball
values.description: Lets a trainer attempt a Capture Roll to catch a Pokémon. This pokéball has a built-in timer. You can take the Utilize action to activate it. values.name: Trainer's License
values.description:
Only licensed trainers are permitted to capture Pokémon, and this license identifies you as having such authorization. It also allows trainers to gain access to special services at Pokémon centers and to purchase goods at the Poké Mart.

Trainers can lose their license for attacking other trainers or their Pokémon, or failing to take care of their own Pokémon.

values.name: Binoculars

values.name: Camping Kettle
values.description: A kettle that can be placed in or above a campfire for heating up liquids.

values.name: Camping Stove
values.description: A light, portable stove that is heated by wood chips.

values.name: Canteen
values.description: A metal or plastic canteen to carry water or other liquids.

values.name: Energy Cell
values.description: A small, flat disc, used to provide energy for various powered objects.

values.name: Flashlight
values.description: Casts bright light in a 15-foot cone and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Requires a new energy cell after 4 hours of use.

values.name: Solar Flashlight
values.description: Casts bright light in a 15-foot cone and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Charges in the sunlight; for each hour doing so, it gains an hour of use, up to 4 hours.

values.name: Flint and Steel
values.description: A 'D'-shaped piece of steel and a square of flint to make a spark to start a fire.

values.name: Climber's Kit
values.description: Includes special pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness. You have advantage on climbing checks and you can't fall more than 25 ft if you fail. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

values.name: Cooking Kit
values.description: Includes pots, pans, utensils, and molds for cooking. Used to make foods while in a kitchen or similar facility. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

values.name: Diver's Kit
values.description: Includes a wetsuit, diving belt, mask, fins, and air tanks. While worn it reduces your movement speed by 20ft, but gives you a swimming speed of 30ft. In addition, you have 2 hours of air, can dive a depth of 200ft, and aren't affected by the water's temperature.

values.name: Gardener's Kit
values.description: Includes clippers, gloves, a spade, and a watering pale. It's everything needed to gather and care for plants, berries, and apricorn trees. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

values.name: Lantern
values.description: Casts bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an aditional 30 feet. Requires a new energy cell after 4 hours of use.

values.name: Solar Lantern
values.description: Casts bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an aditional 30 feet. Needs to recharge in the sunlight for a short rest, but otherwise provides 4 hours of light.

values.name: Mess Kit
values.description: This stainless steel box contains a cup and simple cutlery. The box clamps together, and one side can be used as a cooking pan, and the other as a plate or shallow bowl.

values.name: Multi-tool
values.description: A tool with pliers, scissors, knife, and other basic tools. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

values.name: Pocket Knife
values.description: A small pocket knife with micro tools. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

values.name: Camping Ration
values.description: An air-tight packet of freeze-dried food. Add hot water to reconstitute. Provides a daily meal for one person.

values.name: Rebreather
values.description: A small breathing apparatus that allows breathing underwater. Its filter needs to be replaced after 4 hours of use.

values.name: Rebreather Filter
values.description: A filter for a rebreather.

values.name: Sleeping Bag
values.description: A sleeping bag for one person.

values.name: Solar Charger
values.description: A solar charger stores sunlight during a short rest during the day, and can be used to charge two energy cells during a long rest.

values.name: Small Tent
values.description: A tent for two people.

values.name: Large Tent
values.description: A tent for four people.

values.name: Artisan Tools
values.description: Tools used by tradesmen, such as calligraphers, artists, or smiths. Choose one type of artisan tool upon purchase. Add your proficiency modifier to related checks.

values.name: Thieves' Tools
values.description: You can add your proficiency modifier to checks when disarming traps or opening locks.

values.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
values.description: Contains a backpack, climber's kit, flashlight, 5 energy cells, flint and steel, 10 camping rations, a canteen, and 30 feet of rope.

values.name: Explorer's Pack
values.description: Contains a backpack, sleeping bag, mess kit, flint and steel, flashlight, 5 energy cells, 10 camping rations, a canteen, and 30 feet of rope.

values.name: Filcher's Pack
